review:
Two divine brothers fight it out on DuelReels. VS symbols that would join a win expand over their reel, and the winning duelist's multiplier applies to the whole reel.

The new bit is FS DuelReels: they duel two free spins values, and the winners add up to set your bonus length. Bonus upgrades can also kick you up to Zeus Fury or Eternal Destruction. A fresh angle on a familiar mechanic. 15,000x max.
